annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes OneCoin packages as a way to obtain large, largely passive returns, including claims that a €25,000 package can become €100,000 or more through automatic token splits and that a €5,000 package can produce €23,562. It directs viewers to a OneCoin signup URL and a Skype contact while presenting package purchases, projected earnings, and bonuses as participation opportunities. The video also shows multi-level matching and pairing bonuses tied to sponsors and package levels, reinforcing recruitment-based earning claims.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: S05 fits because the video solicits purchases of OneCoin/token packages and links them to projected appreciation, token splits, and substantial earnings; S06 is separately supported by the displayed pairing and matching-bonus structure requiring direct sponsors and multiple levels.
